name: ACIS (NOAA Regional Climate Centers)
summary: US station and gridded climate data from the NOAA Regional Climate Centers' Applied Climate Information System: station metadata, daily/monthly/annual station data, multi-station data, grids and area metadata.
notes: Keyless. Simple calls are GET query strings; anything richer (elems objects with reduce, interval, smry, add) goes as one JSON object in the params parameter.
Units are US customary: temperature in °F, precipitation, snow and depth in inches, elevation in feet.
Missing values come back as "M", trace precipitation/snow as "T", accumulated values with an "A" suffix. Errors come as an "error" key, not an HTTP error.
Ambiguous station ids need their id type appended after a space (e.g. 'BUFthr 9'). Observation times are Local Standard Time.

endpoints.name: Find stations
endpoints.summary: Metadata of stations in an area, optionally only those reporting given elements in a date range.

sids.description: Station ids instead of an area (cannot combine with area keys).

cwa.description: NWS County Warning Area, e.g. BOX.

elems.description: Comma-separated element codes, e.g. maxt,mint,pcpn,snow,snwd,avgt,hdd,cdd,gdd, or monthly shortcuts like mly_max_maxt.

sdate.description: Start date yyyy-mm-dd (or yyyy, yyyy-mm); por for period of record. Needs edate.

edate.description: End date yyyy-mm-dd (or yyyy, yyyy-mm); por for period of record. Needs sdate.

date.description: A single date (yyyy-mm-dd, yyyy-mm or yyyy), in place of sdate/edate.

meta.description: Comma-separated metadata codes: name, state, sids, ll, elev, uid, county, climdiv, valid_daterange.

params_json.description: The whole request as one JSON object, for options a flat query cannot express (elems objects with reduce, interval, duration, smry). Replaces the other inputs.

endpoints.name: Get gridded data
endpoints.summary: Values from a gridded dataset (NRCC, PRISM, ...) at a point, over states or a bounding box.

grid.description: Grid code: 1 NRCC Interpolated, 2 Multi-Sensor Precip, 3 NRCC Hi-Res, 21 PRISM.

loc.description: Longitude,latitude of a point; the nearest grid point is returned.

sdate.description: Start date yyyy-mm-dd (or yyyy, yyyy-mm); por for period of record. Needs edate.

edate.description: End date yyyy-mm-dd (or yyyy, yyyy-mm); por for period of record. Needs sdate.

meta.description: ll and/or elev of each grid point.

params_json.description: The whole request as one JSON object, for options a flat query cannot express (elems objects with reduce, interval, duration, smry). Replaces the other inputs.

endpoints.name: Get area metadata
endpoints.summary: Ids, names, bounding boxes or GeoJSON of states, counties, climate divisions, CWAs or basins.
